description: Static, reproducible analytics model. Tables are arrays of records; source text is accessed through detail paths.

attention_minus_budget.eligibility: Observed party proposal with all 27 expenditure areas
attention_minus_budget.limitation: Descriptive comparison only; speeches may occur after the budget proposal

new_job_ads.unit: unique ad IDs per month and role

validated_vote_direction_pairs.reason: No reviewed vote-to-versioned-provision links or validated direction annotations

dim_actor.source: GOV is a collective government proposal, not an individual party

dim_expenditure_area.limitations: Historical area names and definitions may change; fact rows preserve source names

dim_law_snapshot.grain: One parsed statute snapshot in one pool
dim_law_snapshot.limitations: v1 and v2 overlap; not verified effective law at speech date

dim_topic.grain: One topic in one model run

fact_budget_frame.limitations: Incomplete years and missing party proposals must not be imputed

fact_budget_outturn.grain: One budget year and expenditure area
fact_budget_outturn.limitations: Historical area definitions must be checked before joining a budget proposal

fact_job_junior_month.grain: One month and role with junior data
fact_job_junior_month.limitations: Absent rows are missing, not zero

fact_job_technology.limitations: A mention may be optional or negated

fact_job_year_role.limitations: Annual distinct-ad counts; do not sum employer counts across months

fact_language_area.grain: One corpus, method, session, party and area
fact_language_area.limitations: Word matches are topic attention, not support

fact_language_coverage.grain: One corpus, method, session and party
fact_language_coverage.limitations: Zero matches are not evidence of silence

fact_law_mention_candidate.grain: One speech and named law candidate
fact_law_mention_candidate.limitations: Snapshot not verified effective at speech date; provision and direction unresolved

fact_law_provision.grain: One parsed provision in a snapshot
fact_law_provision.limitations: Metadata only; full text remains in versioned source shard

fact_motion_vote_link.grain: One cited motion per roll call
fact_motion_vote_link.limitations: A citation is not the outcome of the individual motion

fact_party_vote.grain: One party in one imported roll call
fact_party_vote.limitations: Ja means yes to the committee proposal, not every cited bill
fact_party_vote.source: Parliament vote export; modal position derived from member counts

fact_point_citation.limitations: A citation does not establish support

fact_point_reservation.limitations: A citation does not establish support

fact_proposition_point_link.grain: One proposition cited at a decision point

fact_rfc_version.limitations: Requirement counts are heuristic extraction, not matched changes

fact_speech_vote_candidate.limitations: Similarity is not a stance or truthfulness judgment

fact_topic_session_party.grain: One model, session, party and topic
fact_topic_session_party.limitations: Word shares include an unclustered category
fact_topic_session_party.source: Separate legacy and current topic exports

fact_umap_sample.grain: One sampled text segment in a model run
fact_umap_sample.limitations: Sample coordinates are not comparable across model runs or ideological positions

mart_budget_language_gap.grain: One corpus, method, session, party and area with a complete party frame
mart_budget_language_gap.limitations: Descriptive difference in percentage points; no stance or causal inference. Missing/incomplete party frames excluded.
mart_budget_language_gap.source: Exact-key join of corrected party frame and language audit

mart_party_agreement.grain: One session and ordered party pair
